description: Classic Defenders are known for injector and crank sensor wear and head-gasket failure on the Td5, and cylinder-head cracking plus cooling-system neglect on the 200Tdi/300Tdi — with the 300Tdi/200Tdi's timing belt being a critical interval-service item. We replace whatever's worn or damaged as standard on every classic rebuild. The new-generation Defender's Ingenium diesel shares the same broad timing-chain and injector-seal pattern found across the rest of the modern Land Rover range.

callout.title: A Well-Documented Issue
callout.body: 200Tdi injector seal leaks and timing chain wear are widely documented across Land Rover specialist forums and official TSBs.

heroHook.title: Include In Hero Hook:
heroHook.body: Yes — both verified: 200Tdi widely documented with multiple TSBs; the wear pattern is well established and something our Land Rover specialists repair regularly.

features.title: New Timing Chains
features.body: Replaced as standard (where worn or damaged)

features.title: Peace Of Mind
features.body: No hidden extras — just a stronger, longer-lasting engine
